name: Furosemide
lead: Furosemide (Lasix) is a potent loop diuretic used to treat fluid overload from heart failure, kidney disease and cirrhosis, and sometimes high blood pressure. It is prescription-only in nearly all countries.

It turns up in appearance and bodybuilding circles as a way to drop water weight quickly. For face slimming it is both dangerous and ineffective, since any change reflects temporary fluid loss, not fat or bone.

paras: Furosemide blocks the sodium-potassium-chloride cotransporter in the thick ascending limb of the loop of Henle, so the kidney excretes more sodium, chloride, potassium and water. Onset is quick and the effect is strong, which makes electrolyte disturbances easy to cause.

Misuse can cause dehydration, low potassium, sodium and magnesium, cramps, dizziness, kidney injury, hearing damage and dangerous heart rhythms. It can interact with many drugs and is contraindicated in anuria and sulfonamide hypersensitivity. Use without medical supervision for cosmetic purposes is unsafe and is prohibited in many sports.
